nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the shadcn-svelte input-group UI primitive, re-exporting the root container and its addon, button, input, text, and textarea parts under both short and prefixed aliases.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript barrel re-exporting Svelte components with dual naming (Root/InputGroup, Addon/InputGroupAddon) for flexible import ergonomics.

nodes.name: input-group-addon.svelte
nodes.summary: Addon slot component for the input group, rendering leading/trailing or block-aligned decorations via tailwind-variants and forwarding focus to the sibling input on click.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Svelte 5 runes ($props, $bindable) and tailwind-variants (tv) with an align variant exposed as InputGroupAddonAlign.

nodes.name: input-group-button.svelte
nodes.summary: Button variant tailored for use inside an input group, wrapping the shared Button component with size presets (xs, sm, icon-xs, icon-sm) and a ghost default.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps the shared Button via ComponentProps and overrides the size prop with InputGroupButtonSize variants.

nodes.name: input-group-input.svelte
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over the shared Input control that strips its border, background, and ring so it blends seamlessly inside an input group.

nodes.name: input-group-text.svelte
nodes.summary: Inline text/icon slot for an input group, rendering muted-foreground content with consistent sizing and spacing.

nodes.name: input-group-textarea.svelte
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper over the shared Textarea control that removes borders, background, and resize handles for embedding inside an input group.

nodes.name: input-group.svelte
nodes.summary: Root container for the input group primitive, a group-scoped div that manages focus-visible, invalid, and alignment states for its child controls and addons.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies heavily on Tailwind group/has-* selectors to react to descendant slot and alignment data attributes.
